The Tech 的 $5 停车验证只适用于官网列出的 Convention C: The Tech’s $5 parking validation applies only at the listed Convention Center and 2nd and San Carlos garages. For visitors sensitive to noise, darkness or crowds, review the sensory guide and choose experiences they can leave comfortably; nobody has to finish an IMAX screening.
